column2: A modified scanner that works out the best module-bay layout for a machine. Double-click it, or right-click and choose Activate.
The chip on its screen matches no known model. Better keep it away from Security.
Work in progress: later versions will read your machines and modules here and find the best layout.
Dev test: put a Module Optimizer on the counter after loading
For testing only. Spawns one on every load.
